generation_prompt: Full-color indoor photograph, eye-level wide shot of a dining table in a modest family dining room under mixed evening light from a pendant lamp and a window on the left. A long rectangular wooden table fills the center, surrounded by six mismatched chairs. The tabletop is set for dinner with a large roasted chicken on an oval ceramic platter, a bowl of green beans, a dish of mashed potatoes, a plate of red vegetables, a basket of torn bread, and a shallow bowl of salad. Six clear wine glasses, water tumblers, folded cloth napkins, and plain silver cutlery form an uneven place setting around the dishes. Near the center, a dark green runner holds a small glass candleholder with a short burning candle, while a few crumbs and a smear of sauce mark the wood. At the head of the table sits a white woman in her forties with fair skin and shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a dark red cardigan over a cream blouse, serving food with a metal spoon. On the left, a Black man in his forties with dark skin and close-cropped hair wears a grey sweater and reaches toward the bread basket. Beside him, a Black girl around ten with dark skin and braided hair wears a yellow sweatshirt and holds a fork above her plate. On the right, an East Asian man in his thirties with fair skin and short black hair wears a navy shirt and looks toward the chicken. Next to him, a white woman in her thirties with fair skin and curly auburn hair wears a green blouse, while a white boy around eight with fair skin and tousled blond hair wears a striped shirt and leans over his plate. In the background, pale walls, a sideboard with stacked dishes, and a window showing a dark blue evening sky frame the meal.
